chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Mūsā ibn ʿĪsā, who said:
I wrote to him: A man upon whom repeating the salat (prayer) becomes obligatory—should he repeat it with adhan and iqamah? So he wrote: “He repeats it with iqamah.”

key_terms.إِقَامَةٍ: the commencement call immediately before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: If someone has to repeat the salat (prayer), should he give both the adhan and iqamah again?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling for one who must repeat the salat (prayer). It states that when repeating the prayer, the iqamah is given, without mentioning a need to repeat the adhan.
